signal: Threekit expanded its AI Suite with the launch of its AI Visual Configurator, its first AI-powered product configuration experience for visual commerce

email.subject1: pipeline Threekit is leaving on the table
email.body1:
Zach, saw Threekit launch the AI Visual Configurator and double down on AI-powered visual commerce.

A new AI product usually opens more in-market accounts across North America than the team can touch before reps ramp, and coverage gaps are where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Threekit off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Zach, quick follow-up for Threekit.

Launching into AI configuration usually pushes the NA number up faster than headcount can. Most teams can't say how many meetings they need to book to hit target, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter gets expensive.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Threekit needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Zach, last bit of proof for Threekit.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Threekit's reply rate likely compares to other SaaS startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Zach, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling North America pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. An AI product launch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your NA motion? I'll tailor it to Threekit either way.
